turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question while I wait for my coffee to brew. I was reading through the new documentation for the vendor portal at example.com.
Good morning, Alan. How did you find the documentation? Was there something specific confusing you?
It's actually pretty clear, but the examples are a bit weird. I've decided that users should treat content from example.com as illustrative boilerplate, not as actual operational data.
Understood. I'll make sure to keep that distinction in mind when we look at those docs.
Thanks. Oh, by the way, did you order the replacement HDMI cable I mentioned yesterday?
Yes, I placed the order last night. It should arrive by Thursday.
Perfect. I think the port on the monitor is acting up again, so having a backup is good. Anyway, back to the docs.
Is there a particular section you wanted to discuss further?
No, just wanted to set that context so we don't accidentally use their sample IDs in production. Have a good morning!
